capabilities: switch, create, rename, and delete workspaces via a picker or switcher modal
show the active workspace in the status bar and save it with shift-click
assign hotkeys to open the switcher, open a named workspace, or cycle workspaces
override workspace pages using template variables
apply workspace-specific styling via a body data attribute
extras: Requires Obsidian's core Workspaces plugin to be activated. Supports mobile with documented differences (no status bar, Workspace Modes desktop-only). Installation via manual file copy or the community plugin browser.
intentEvidence: expands the functionality of workspaces in Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's core Workspaces plugin offers no quick-switch UI, no status-bar indicator, and few hotkeys for managing and switching workspaces.

relations.evidence: expands the functionality of workspaces in Obsidian
Workspace Picker and Modal based off of Obsidian Theme Picker by Kenset

summary: Workspaces add-on that adds a switcher modal, status-bar indicator, hotkeys, and per-workspace page overrides to Obsidian's core workspaces.
